caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture that appears to be a cabinet or small chest on legs. It has a rectangular shape with a flat top and a single front-facing drawer, which is fitted with two small round knobs of a darker wood color. Above the drawer, the front features two recessed rectangular panels with angled top corners, each surrounded by a raised border, displaying a grain pattern typical of oak or similar wood. The cabinet's sides are similarly paneled, with a rectangular frame enclosing a flat wood surface. The structure stands on four turned and carved legs that are connected by low, horizontal stretchers, which are also turned and feature bulbous details, creating a support frame linking all legs. The primary color throughout the object is a warm, medium brown, showing visible wood grain and natural tonal variations. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decoration present in the image. In the bottom left corner of the page, the names "LOUIS. ANNING" appear in small printed letters.
title: Chest on Frame
